annotations.title: Get Australian student visa grant rates

description: Query published Australian student visa grant and refusal decisions (BP0015) with optional filters, monthly results and a breakdown. Results include the official source, period, snapshot and sample notices. Grant rates are aggregate historical statistics for the selected group and do not indicate any individual applicant’s chance of a grant. No rate is given when there are fewer than 30 decisions; 30–99 decisions are flagged as a small sample. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

age.description: Age group, such as 20 to 24 years or 20-24.

breakdown_by.description: Optional grouping dimension. The total and monthly series still use all requested filters.

country.description: Country of citizenship. Use an official name, a Chinese or English alias, or an ISO3 code.

fy.description: Starting year of the Australian financial year. For example, 2025 means July 2025 to June 2026. Use fy or months.

location.description: Applicant location, In Australia (onshore) or Outside Australia (offshore).

months.description: Number of months ending at the snapshot’s latest decision month. Defaults to 12 when fy is absent.

sector.description: Education sector. Use an official name, a slug or a common short name, such as Higher Education, VET, ELICOS or Schools.

snapshotId.description: Optional previously published snapshot ID. Omit for the current snapshot.

state.description: Education provider’s registered state or territory, as an abbreviation such as VIC or a full name such as Victoria.

name: get_student_visa_grant_rates
title: Get Australian student visa grant rates
